newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso pares strength at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso pares strength at close.

text.p: The Mexican same-day peso pared early gains to close just 0.1 of a centavo firmer at 7.5115/7.5150 per dollar on Friday, due to a surge in demand for dollars as the peso reached resistance, traders said.
"Market feeling is that dollars are cheap now. Every time the peso approaches 7.52 per dollar, dealers step in to buy greenbacks," a trader said.
"Even though the (U.S. 30-year Treasury bond yield) is falling, foreigners are not interested in selling dollars at these prices," he added.
The 48-hour and 24-hour contracts were meanwhile 1.3 and 0.5 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.5260/7.5280 and 7.5200/7.5250 per dollar.
Traders said that the peso may have reined in early strength due to local banks buying dollars.
"There may be banks out there covering (dollar) positions ahead of the weekend, but they may also have exercised dollar puts," a trader said, referring to puts sold by the central bank.
